page.overview:
Who is Wallace?

Wallace fought alongside Chun-Li and Ryu against a group of terrorists at a boat dock. With the help of Ryu's powerful martial arts, they were able to defeat the terrorists and save a young boy caught in the crossfire. Later he went to the Interpol office and informed Chun-Li that the terrorists they battled were actually a group of Shadolaw henchman. He informed Chun-Li of a street fighting tournament where Sadler would likely attend.

Wallace is a Caucasian young-man from the United States of America with a tan, good-looks, and neck-length blonde hair that is slick-back and has stubble on his upper-lip. He wears a green dress-coat, a black shirt, and caramel-colored pants.

Though not capable enough in martial arts to compete in Sadler's Second World Fighting Tournament and often lets Chun-Li do all the hand-to-hand combat, he is only skilled at marksmanship.

This competent detective who acts as Chun-Li's fellow Interpol agent who often presents himself as self-assured by teasing and flattering Chun Li with his charm and charisma.
